title: Supply and demand
examples: Teacher, if everyone wants the new phone, why does the price go up?
What happens to the price if a lot of apples are grown?
Can you explain what 'equilibrium' means for prices?

explain.say: Today we will learn about supply and demand in a market.
If demand rises but supply stays the same, prices will tend to rise.

draw.text: High Demand, Low Supply = High Price

explain.say: When demand is high and supply is low, we see a shortage in the market.
Equilibrium is the point where supply and demand match up perfectly.
If the price is too high, supply might drop because it is not profitable.
In real life, think about popular concert tickets for famous bands.

faq.q: Why does a shortage cause prices to rise?
faq.a: When many people want something but there is not enough, sellers can charge more because buyers are willing to pay a higher price.
asks: Why do things cost more when they are rare?
What happens to the price when supply is low?

faq.q: What is the difference between supply and demand?
faq.a: Demand is how much people want to buy, and supply is how much is actually available to buy.
asks: Can you explain supply versus demand?
What do these two words mean in business?

faq.q: What does 'equilibrium' mean for a market?
faq.a: It means the market price is stable because the amount supplied equals the amount demanded.
asks: When are supply and demand balanced?
What is the perfect price point?

faq.q: If the price drops, does that mean demand will go up?
faq.a: Generally, yes. Lower prices make goods more affordable, so more people are willing to buy them.
asks: Will people buy more if it costs less?
How does price affect buying habits?

faq.q: Does the price always go up if demand goes up?
faq.a: Not always, but if supply cannot keep up with the higher demand, then prices usually increase.
asks: Is rising demand always good for prices?
What stops prices from rising when demand is high?

facts: Demand refers to the quantity of a good or service that consumers are willing and able to buy.
Supply refers to the quantity of a good or service that producers are willing and able to sell.
At equilibrium, the quantity supplied equals the quantity demanded.
If demand increases and supply is fixed, the price will generally increase.

quiz.say: If a new video game is released and everyone wants it immediately, what is likely to happen to the price?

options.show: The price will stay the same.
options.say: The price will stay the same.

options.show: It depends on the cost to make it.
options.say: It depends on the cost to make it.

options.show: The price will rise because demand exceeds supply.
options.say: The price will rise because demand exceeds supply.

quiz.why: When demand is much higher than the available supply, sellers can charge more.

wrong.0: This is wrong because falling prices happen when supply is too high, not when demand is too high.
wrong.1: This is wrong because a big gap between supply and demand usually forces a price change.
wrong.2: While cost matters, the immediate market pressure from high demand usually pushes the price up first.

quiz.say: When the amount of apples grown in a year is much higher than what people want to buy, what is the market condition?

options.show: The price will stay the same.
options.say: The price will stay the same.

options.show: There will be a surplus, and prices will likely fall.
options.say: There will be a surplus, and prices will likely fall.

quiz.why: When supply is much greater than demand, sellers must lower prices to sell all the extra goods.

wrong.0: This is wrong because rising prices happen when people want more than is available.
wrong.1: This is wrong because a surplus just means sellers need to lower prices to clear stock.
wrong.2: This is wrong because a large surplus usually forces sellers to compete by lowering prices.

quiz.say: If the market for electric scooters reaches equilibrium, what does that mean?

options.show: The price is at its lowest possible point.
options.say: The price is at its lowest possible point.

options.show: The price is stable because the quantity supplied matches the quantity demanded.
options.say: The price is stable because the quantity supplied matches the quantity demanded.

quiz.why: Equilibrium is the balance point where buyers and sellers agree on a price that clears the market.

wrong.0: This is wrong because the price could be low, but it only has to match the current demand.
wrong.1: This is wrong because equilibrium requires both supply and demand to exist.
wrong.2: This is wrong because if demand was zero, there would be no market to balance.
